The main takeaway from our work is that
in patients with unexplained hyperoxalic aciduria, the possibility of GO deficiency should be considered, and HAO1 gene sequencing performed.
the presence of hyperoxaluria in a patient with CHI should not automatically lead to a diagnosis of PH1.
hyperoxaluria in the presence of normal AGT activity should prompt consideration of a diagnosis of GO deficiency.
